'''Michael Vitarelli''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Glenside Grand Slam]] on 8 January 2000 with Sienar Fleet Systems, according to Scott Anderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d175">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-13-glenside-pa-01-08-00-1st-grand-slamd175/ glenside-pa-01-08-00-1st-grand-slam], DeckTech (Scott "elminstr" Anderson, 13 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-13-glenside-pa-01-08-00-1st-grand-slamd175/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
